messages:
marie chen: Heads-up — after the v2c canary -> prod rollout (started ~10:42 UTC) we're seeing a big p95 spike on text-generation for shard-us-east-1/gpu-pool-2. p95 went from ~120ms -> ~410ms. KV-cache hit rate dropped sharply. Anyone oncall?

samir patel: I'm on it. Which tenant/route looks worst?

marie chen: tenant=retail-batch, route=/v1/generate/text. Perf dashboard: https://perf.redwood/graphs/retail-batch (nv). Perf-bot should have posted the alert summary.

perf-bot: alert: perf-spike detected for tenant=retail-batch. p95=410ms (+240%), throughput -25%, kv_cache_hit=62% (baseline ~94%), kernel_fallback_rate=18%. Incident ID: PERF-1840.

aj roy: can you paste a profiler snapshot? I want kernel selection traces + batcher stats.

noah kim: fwiw I checked token counts on a sample of failing requests — tokenizer v2c increases token counts for several long queries (seq tail shifted from ~500 to ~1100 tokens in some cases).

marie chen: profiler dump (redacted) below:
```
# /profiles/1840001234_dump
batcher: avg_batch_size=3.1 (was 7.8 pre-rollout)
queue_depth: 14 -> 28
kvcache: hit_rate=0.62, miss_rate=0.38
kernel_selector.log: selected_kernel=matmul_fallback_v1 for 18% of calls, fallback_reason="missing_opt_meta"
latencies: gpu_compute_ms=310, copy_ms=40, overhead_ms=60
```

samir patel: grep of runtime logs around the rollout: 
`kvcache.lookup_miss tenant=retail-batch count=4123 service=runtime shard=us-east-1`
also seeing more frequent evictions: `kvcache.evict reason=pad_overflow count=890`

aj roy: kernel_selector picking matmul_fallback_v1 because model metadata tag `optimized_attention=true` is missing in model package v2c. That explains the kernel fallback (slower kernels) and a lot of extra compute per token.

noah kim: tokenizer change increases token count -> longer seq shapes -> less batching headroom and more padding. More padding reduces KV cache prefix reuse, increasing miss rate. So two orthogonal changes (tokenizer + missing model opt meta) compound to produce the spike.

marie chen: thanks. Canary is at 30% across the region per deploy-bot — can we pause/rollback?

deploy-bot: Canary status: v2c at 30% (3/10 canary targets). Action required: rollback or continue. Pause requested by @marie chen. Rollback URL: https://deploy.redwood/rollbacks/xyz

marie chen: Pausing now and initiating rollback of canary slices. Monitoring.

aj roy: quick mitigation options: 1) Re-add model metadata tag `optimized_attention=true` to the model package and redeploy model artifact (fast). 2) Rollback tokenizer to v2b for the model family (slower, needs re-release). 3) Short-term batching tweak: allow batcher to compact sequences by token budget (risky).

samir patel: apply 1) first — low risk and should flip kernel selection back to optimized path. aj can you open a fast-change PR?

aj roy: opening PR for model metadata tag + quick redeploy to canary (will force kernel re-eval on model load). Also adding a quick diag script to assert kernel_selector picks the optimized kernel for synthetic seq shapes.

perf-bot: snapshot post-pause: p95=150ms (10min after pause), throughput back to ~95% baseline, kv_cache_hit up to 90% in sampled window.

noah kim: follow-ups: add a rollout checklist gate to verify model metadata and run token-distribution check against prod traffic. Create PERF ticket.

samir patel: filed PERF-712: "rollout guard: verify model opt metadata + tokenizer seq-distribution test". Assign to @noah kim.

marie chen: action items: aj -> PR + canary redeploy with metadata flag; noah -> postmortem + rollout guard; samir -> monitor for regression and update runbook.

aj roy: PR created: https://git.redwood/models/patches/1234. Quick test script added: `scripts/test_kernel_selector.sh` (simulates seq=512, 1024, 1536). Please run during canary.

marie chen: excellent. Once aj's redeploy completes we'll watch kernel_fallback_rate and kv_cache hit % for 30min window.

noah kim: I'll draft a short postmortem and include a new automated check: "model-artifact contains optimized_attention flag" and "tokenizer delta vs prod seq histogram".

marie chen: thanks all — big one but looks like a clear combo cause. Tag me on PR and ping when canary is back. :thumbsup:

samir patel: noted. Adding a permanent alert for kernel_fallback_rate > 5% to catch similar regressions earlier.

perf-bot: closing incident PERF-1840 (status: mitigated) — follow-ups tracked in PERF-712 and models PR 1234.

marie chen: closing thread, will update once postmortem done.
